marta: quick check — i'm trying to collapse the 'namespace + label' pin model into a smaller surface. sketch attached below.
lee: +1 to reducing fields, but we need a migration story. existing clients assume separate namespace key.
sanjay: what are we calling the single field? `pin_scope`? `binding`? keep it explicit so ops can query.
ryan: can we encode an opaque canonical id and keep human label as optional? then clients can opt-in to resolve semantics.
tess: example payload idea:
```
pin: {
  id: "ns:tenantA|lbl:recommender-v12",   # canonical string used in routing
  label: "recommender-v12",              # human friendly
  namespace: "tenantA",                  # optional (backcompat)
  lease_ms: 3600000,
  affinity: "soft",                       # soft|hard
}
```
lee: i like the canonical string for routing. two concerns: 1) how do we handle partial pins (only label provided) and 2) queries for telemetry/ownership?
marta: proposal: accept three shapes — full (id+label+namespace), label-only, and legacy (namespace+label). resolution rules: prefer `id` if present, otherwise build id from namespace+label, otherwise label-only fallback using default namespace.
ryan: fallback rules are fine. need clear semantics for `affinity=hard` -> prevents fallback to other variants. also how service-level rollouts interpret lease_ms.
sanjay: ops concern: we must surface an explicit `origin` tag (ui/deploy-api/auto-rollout) so downstream observability can filter churn.
tess: +1 to `origin`. also suggest `compat_tags: ["legacy-namespace"]` when we synthesize id from legacy fields.
ops-bot: deploy-note: schema change flagged — will require a short migration window for dedicated allocator. ping @sanjay for rollout plan.
lee: migration plan idea: allow both shapes for 4 weeks; emit warnings in logs when legacy fields used; feed telemetry to quantify usage.
marta: final question — do we want the canonical id to be stable across minor label renames? if not, rolling rename will break pin lookups.
ryan: stability preference: make id content-hash when generated from model artifact metadata, otherwise a deterministic concat of namespace+label+version. avoid freeform random ids.
sanjay: i'll draft a tiny RFC with these resolution rules, `origin`, `compat_tags`, and the 4-week dual-shape window. i'll include example queries for ops. thanks.
